name: paper_pseudo_ocv_charge
description: Stage 0 (LFP cells only): pseudo-OCV C/20 charge, opposite direction to 01_pseudo_ocv_discharge.json
comment: Only needed for LFP cells, to average against the C/20 discharge pass and cancel voltage hysteresis (Kang et al.). Precondition: fully discharge the cell (to min_v) and rest >=1h before starting this file. NMC/NCA cells (cellAlex as currently configured in the library): skip this file, 01_pseudo_ocv_discharge.json alone is sufficient. If running on an LFP cell, change 'cell' below to your LFP entry (e.g. 'LFP-3.2V-3200mAh') first. Note: like every charge command on this hardware, the device's own CC-CV backstop still applies near the top of charge (a brief CV/taper phase before cutoff) -- this is a hardware characteristic of the EBC-A20's charge command, not something this framework can bypass. If that tail distorts your OCV curve, trim samples after the device leaves 'charge' mode (see the CSV's mode column) before use.
